messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

function.name: SimpleQuestion_ask
function.description: Presents a simple question based on the provided context and expects an answer from a predefined set of options. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

question.description: The question posed to the user.

answer.description: The selected answer to the question, which must be one of the provided options.

context.description: The context or scenario in which the question is being asked, providing additional information to the user.

message.content:
Here’s a quick rundown of the Canadian federal holidays that create “long weekends” in 2023 (i.e., a holiday falling on a weekday that extends the weekend):

| Holiday | 2023 Date | Observed (if needed) | Typical Long‑Weekend Span |
|---------|-----------|----------------------|---------------------------|
| **New Year’s Day** | Jan 1 (​Sunday) | Observed Jan 2 (Monday) | **Jan 1–3** (Sun–Tue) |
| **Good Friday** | Apr 7 (​Friday) | – | **Apr 7–8** (Fri–Sat) |
| **Victoria Day** | May 22 (​Monday) | – | **May 20–22** (Sat–Mon) |
| **Canada Day** | Jul 1 (​Saturday) | Observed Jul 3 (Monday) | **Jul 1–3** (Sat–Mon) |
| **Labour Day** | Sep 4 (​Monday) | – | **Sep 2–4** (Sat–Mon) |
| **Thanksgiving** | Oct 9 (​Monday) | – | **Oct 7–9** (Sat–Mon) |
| **Remembrance Day** | Nov 11 (​Friday) | – | **Nov 11–13** (Fri–Sun) |
| **Christmas Day** | Dec 25 (​Monday) | – | **Dec 23–25** (Sat–Mon) |
| **Boxing Day** | Dec 26 (​Tuesday) | – | **Dec 26–28** (Tue–Thu) |

> **Quick Takeaway:**  
> • **January 1–3** (New Year’s)  
> • **April 7–8** (Good Friday)  
> • **May 20–22** (Victoria Day)  
> • **July 1–3** (Canada Day)  
> • **September 2–4** (Labour Day)  
> • **October 7–9** (Thanksgiving)  
> • **November 11–13** (Remembrance Day)  
> • **December 23–25** (Christmas)  
> • **December 26–28** (Boxing Day)

These are the federal holidays that give Canadians a chance to stretch a weekend into a three‑day break. If you’re targeting a specific province, let me know and I can add provincial holidays (e.g., Family Day, Civic Holiday, etc.).
